description: The capability of a machine to learn, reason, solve problems, make decisions, and understand language.
A cloud computing platform, AWS provides on-demand infrastructure, platform, and security services for building, deploying, and securing applications without managing physical data centers.
A type of AI that creates new content, such as text, images, code, audio, or video, by learning patterns from large amounts of training data.
An AI model trained on large amounts of text to understand and generate human language.
An open standard introduced by Anthropic that lets AI assistants connect to tools, data sources, repositories, and services through a common protocol, reducing the need for custom integrations.
The process of training a computer system to improve its performance by learning from data and experience.
An AI architecture that improves a large language model’s responses by retrieving relevant external information before generating an answer.
A technology that uses software robots, or bots, to automate repetitive, rule-based tasks typically performed by humans on computers.
